description: C14 — 法国防御古典变例，王翼g4-g5突破范例

intro.popup_en: Pawn-Chain Direction, Lesson 3: The e5-pawn has two supports, d4 and f4. Black's ...c5 attacks only the d4 side, so it is not enough to break the chain. White's kingside breakthrough is the highlight.
intro.popup:
兵链方向第3课

e5有d4和f4两个根部支撑
黑方c5仅攻d4一侧，效果有限
本局真正亮点：白方王翼突破！

outro.popup_en: The e5-pawn is supported by both d4 and f4, so ...c5 attacks only one base and has limited effect. White breaks through with g4-g5-gxh6, opens the g-file, and exposes Black's king.
outro.popup:
总结：e5有d4和f4双根部，c5仅攻d4一侧效果有限
白方g4-g5-gxh6王翼强力突破
打开g线，黑王岌岌可危！

moves.popup_en: e5! White establishes the e5-d4 pawn chain. After f4, the pawn on e5 will have two supports, d4 and f4.
moves.popup:
e5！兵链形成！e5-d4
后续f4加入后，e5将有d4和f4两个根部支撑

moves.popup_en: f4! This pawn also supports e5. With both d4 and f4 defending it, Black must attack both bases to break the chain completely.
moves.popup:
f4！f4也是e5的根部
e5现在有d4和f4两个根部支撑
攻击根部需同时威胁两侧才彻底

moves.popup_en: ...a6 is a defensive move.
Nf3 develops a knight.
...c5 attacks the base on d4, but e5 is also supported by f4. Black attacks only one base, so the challenge is not decisive.
moves.popup:
c5攻击根部d4
但注意：e5还有f4这个根部未受攻击
c5仅攻单根，效果不够彻底

moves.popup_en: dxc5 accepts the exchange. The d4-pawn disappears, but f4 still supports e5, so the pawn chain survives.
moves.popup:
dxc5白轻松接受
d4消失，但e5仍由f4支撑，兵链未破

moves.popup_en: ...Nxc5 places Black's knight on the important square c5.
Qd2 prepares queenside castling.
...Nc6 brings in a reinforcement.
O-O-O castles queenside and sets up the opposite-wing race.
...b5!! Black attacks on the queenside, following the direction of its own pawn chain. The race on opposite wings begins in earnest.
moves.popup:
b5！！黑方沿兵链方向后翼进攻
双翼竞速真正开始！

moves.popup_en: Kb1 moves the king away from the diagonal.
...Bd7 develops Black's bishop.
Ne2 reroutes a piece for the coming play.
...b4! Black continues advancing on the queenside.
Ned4! White's knight occupies d4 forcefully.
...Nxd4 exchanges knights.
Nxd4 recaptures with White's knight.
...O-O castles kingside.
g4!! White attacks on the kingside. This is the game's central idea: break through at the head of the pawn chain.
moves.popup:
g4！！白方王翼进攻！
这才是本局真正主题：沿兵链头部方向发动突破！

moves.popup_en: ...Rfc8 prepares Black's counterplay.
g5!! White continues the kingside attack. The g4-g5 advance drives toward Black's king.
moves.popup:
g5！！白方王翼总攻！
g4-g5连续推进，直逼黑王阵地！

moves.popup_en: ...h6! Black must respond and challenges whether White's g5-pawn has advanced too far.
moves.popup:
h6！黑方被迫应对
挑战白g5是否过伸

moves.popup_en: gxh6! White opens the g-file with the g4-g5-gxh6 breakthrough. Black's king is now exposed along the file.
moves.popup:
gxh6！g线打开！
g4-g5-gxh6王翼突破成功
黑王g线门户洞开！

moves.popup_en: ...gxh6 recaptures, but the g-file is completely open and Black's king is in danger. This is a classic kingside breakthrough.
moves.popup:
gxh6黑回吃
g线彻底打开，黑王危在旦夕！
——王翼突破的经典范例！
